nodes.name: Grading session
nodes.responsibility: Stages a read-only workspace and grades the ungraded runs in chunks, in one resumed session of the grader chosen by name

nodes.name: Codex grader
nodes.responsibility: One grader runner: a resumed thread, pictures attached, usage read as the thread's running total

nodes.name: Claude grader
nodes.responsibility: The other grader runner: a resumed session, read-only tools, pictures opened from the workspace

nodes.name: Report
nodes.responsibility: Joins every run with the verdict of each grader that graded it, and says where two graders agree

nodes.name: Codex CLI
nodes.responsibility: The author, and one of the two graders; pinned to an exact version a batch refuses to differ from

nodes.name: Claude CLI
nodes.responsibility: The other grader, run with read-only tools and none of the operator's settings

nodes.name: Skill citations
nodes.responsibility: Keeps the batch's copy of the candidate skill, and holds every cited passage, catalogue row and rubric section to a heading the skill has

nodes.name: Grader retry
nodes.responsibility: Holds each answer to what the report reads, and asks once more in the same session for the runs an answer fell short on

nodes.name: Comparison
nodes.responsibility: Per scenario, per workflow and for the broad case: what moved between the arms, a mean held to the noise the batch measures in itself
